body:
The two PRs this issue refers to:

- #12179: the build fix. It adds `apps/site/vercel.json`, whose `buildCommand` is `cd ../.. && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/site`, the command CI's `Build Docs` runs, and whose `installCommand` stays `pnpm i`. It can merge as soon as it is green. The first production deployment Vercel builds after that merge is what proves the fix.
- #12182: the docs deploy moves into a GitHub Actions workflow, `docs-deploy.yml`, which runs every 6 hours or on manual dispatch on free public-repo runners, and `git.deploymentEnabled: false` turns Vercel's own Git-triggered builds off. That branch is stacked on #12179's commit.

Neither PR carries a closing keyword for this issue. Close it by hand once a production deployment is READY and objectui.org shows post-2026-09-06 content.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Triage: grade completed. The filer's `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:devx` stand; `area:devpath` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` added, because the fix is in the maintainer's own PRs

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T03:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Thread-read: `6117322486`.

- **State:** the work is already in flight in the maintainer's session: PR objectui#12179 (the build command) and PR objectui#12182 (the Actions deploy, stacked on it). Both are drafts by `hotlong`. So no seat claims this card. `pm:awaiting-maintainer` keeps it off the claimable queue. The close also needs the maintainer's Vercel reading (a READY production deployment).
- **Why p1 stands:** objectui.org has been frozen since 2026-09-06. Every `main` commit also bills a failing Vercel build (about 4.6 build-minutes each, per the card's reading). Until PR objectui#12179 merges, each merge adds to that cost. So merging it as soon as it is green is the cheap step.
- **Order:** PR objectui#12179 first, as the card says. A READY deploy after it proves the fix. PR objectui#12182 is the separate cost change and rides after.
- ⛔ **No `prebuild` hook,** as the card says. #7986's single build order stays.

Fixed by #12182 (merged as 7e30d0b6). The docs site now builds on GitHub Actions with the same turbo command CI runs. First production deploy: run https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/38205888262 → dpl_6eDjToaVU2VPLKUk7AZjtagmgpUE READY (2026-10-12 05:03 UTC), and objectui.org now serves it. This is the first successful production deploy since 2026-09-06. Vercel Git deployments are off (`git.deploymentEnabled: false`), so no Vercel build minutes are billed from here on.
